decision.observation: The cast line goes up-right toward the stump, not the pond—facing was wrong. Farmer at ~(0.61,0.42); water lies directly below.
decision.hypothesis: Facing south first (tap S) then holding C will aim the bobber into the pond.
decision.memory: Fishing loop: face water, hold C to cast, press C at the bobber dip; if the bar minigame opens, LMB holds/releases keep it on the fish. Casts fail silently when facing away from water.
